title: Answer: no account of information, which cells and tissues process bioelectrically

statements.text: Basal cognition takes no position on what information is. It uses information in the working sense of the information sciences: cells and tissues process it, bioelectric signaling is an information processing mode older than neurons, and a bioelectric pattern is an information medium that stores a target anatomy apart from the current one. Whether a signal acts as information depends on the receiver: a very low-energy signal can change a complex mind greatly because it is treated as information by the machinery that hosts it.

sources.quote: bioelectric signaling is an ancient information processing modality that pre-dates neurons and brains
an orthogonal information medium that is used to guide future changes of anatomy
massive changes can be made in those systems by a very low-energy signal because it is treated as information in the context of a complex host computational machinery.
